statement: Huang said Nvidia remained confident it could grow revenue 70% year over year while unconstrained customer demand growth exceeds 100% annually, implying demand outpaces supply.
why: The gap between the growth the vendor can deliver and the growth customers would take is the cleanest statement of how supply-limited the category is.

impact.mechanism: Guidance for 70% revenue growth against demand growth above 100% keeps allocation tight and supports pricing on merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: remained confident it could grow revenue 70% year over year

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of CEO conference remarks rather than a formal guidance filing.

dispersion: Unconstrained customer demand growth described as exceeding 100% annually, above what Nvidia says it can supply.
